 WHERE NOT (hex(encode(s.props_json,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(concat('{"107":true',CASE WHEN b.props_json='{}' THEN '}' ELSE concat(',',substring(b.props_json,2)) END),'UTF-8')))
 OR get_json_object(b.props_json,'$.107') IS NOT NULL

SELECT count(*) FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.edge_current VERSION AS OF 1 a
 FULL OUTER JOIN client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.edge_current VERSION AS OF 0 b ON a.id=b.id
 LEFT JOIN client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.publication_stage_r89 VERSION AS OF 0 s ON b.id=s.id
 WHERE a.id IS NULL OR b.id IS NULL OR NOT (hex(encode(a.source_system,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(b.source_system,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (a.rel_type_id <=> b.rel_type_id) OR NOT (a.id <=> b.id) OR NOT (a.source_type <=> b.source_type) OR NOT (a.source_id <=> b.source_id) OR NOT (a.target_type <=> b.target_type) OR NOT (a.target_id <=> b.target_id) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.schema_revision,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(b.schema_revision,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (a.entity_version <=> CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN s.entity_version ELSE b.entity_version END) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.props_json,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN s.props_json ELSE b.props_json END,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.retained_json,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(b.retained_json,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.order_key,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(b.order_key,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.source_feed,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(b.source_feed,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.source_epoch,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN s.source_epoch ELSE b.source_epoch END,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (a.source_position <=> b.source_position) OR NOT (a.published_at <=> CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN s.published_at ELSE b.published_at END) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.lookup_hash,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(b.lookup_hash,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.apply_batch_id,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN s.apply_batch_id ELSE b.apply_batch_id END,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.source_cursor_json,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN s.source_cursor_json ELSE b.source_cursor_json END,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT (hex(encode(a.source_delivery_id,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN s.source_delivery_id ELSE b.source_delivery_id END,'UTF-8')))
SELECT count(*),count(DISTINCT id),count_if(entity_version=1) FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.edge_current VERSION AS OF 1

SELECT count(*) FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.publication_stage_r89 VERSION AS OF 0 s

 payload,sha2(payload,256),schema_revision,current_timestamp(),apply_batch_id
 FROM (SELECT *,to_json(named_struct('source_system',source_system,'rel_type_id',rel_type_id,'id',id,'source_type',source_type,'source_id',source_id,'target_type',target_type,'target_id',target_id,'schema_revision',schema_revision,'entity_version',entity_version,'props_json',props_json,'retained_json',retained_json,'order_key',order_key,'source_feed',source_feed,'source_epoch',source_epoch,'source_position',source_position,'published_at',published_at,'lookup_hash',lookup_hash,'apply_batch_id',apply_batch_id,'source_cursor_json',source_cursor_json,'source_delivery_id',source_delivery_id),map('ignoreNullFields','false')) payload FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.publication_stage_r89 VERSION AS OF 0)

CREATE TABLE client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.publication_stage_r89 USING DELTA AS SELECT source_system AS source_system,rel_type_id AS rel_type_id,id AS id,source_type AS source_type,source_id AS source_id,target_type AS target_type,target_id AS target_id,schema_revision AS schema_revision,entity_version AS entity_version,props_json AS props_json,retained_json AS retained_json,order_key AS order_key,source_feed AS source_feed,'entropy-publication-r89' AS source_epoch,source_position AS source_position,current_timestamp() AS published_at,lookup_hash AS lookup_hash,'r89' AS apply_batch_id,concat('{"xid":"9007199254740995","seq":"',cast(id AS STRING),'"}') AS source_cursor_json,concat('r89:edge:',cast(id AS STRING)) AS source_delivery_id FROM (SELECT source_system,rel_type_id,id,source_type,source_id,target_type,target_id,'synthetic-r1' schema_revision,cast(1 AS BIGINT) entity_version,
      concat('{"107":true',CASE WHEN (CASE pmod(id,8)
      WHEN 0 THEN '{}'
      WHEN 1 THEN '{"101":null}'
      WHEN 2 THEN '{"102":9007199254740993,"103":1.2300000000000000001}'
      WHEN 3 THEN '{"104":"2026-10-06T09:30:00.123456789-04:00"}'
      ELSE concat('{"105":"',sha2(cast(id AS STRING),256),
        concat_ws('',transform(sequence(0,cast(63+pmod(id,65) AS INT)), block -> sha2(concat('entropy-r86:',cast(id AS STRING),':',cast(block AS STRING)),256))),
        '","106":',cast(pmod(id,100) AS STRING),'}') END)='{}' THEN '}' ELSE concat(',',substring((CASE pmod(id,8)
      WHEN 0 THEN '{}'
      WHEN 1 THEN '{"101":null}'
      WHEN 2 THEN '{"102":9007199254740993,"103":1.2300000000000000001}'
      WHEN 3 THEN '{"104":"2026-10-06T09:30:00.123456789-04:00"}'
      ELSE concat('{"105":"',sha2(cast(id AS STRING),256),
        concat_ws('',transform(sequence(0,cast(63+pmod(id,65) AS INT)), block -> sha2(concat('entropy-r86:',cast(id AS STRING),':',cast(block AS STRING)),256))),
        '","106":',cast(pmod(id,100) AS STRING),'}') END),2)) END) props_json,concat('{"unknown":{"ordinal":',cast(id AS STRING),',"nested":[null,true,"opaque"]}}') retained_json,
      cast(NULL AS STRING) order_key,'synthetic' source_feed,'scale-1' source_epoch,cast(NULL AS BIGINT) source_position,
      timestamp '2026-10-06 00:00:00' published_at,sha2(to_json(named_struct('source_system',source_system,'rel_type_id',rel_type_id,'id',id)),256) lookup_hash,
      'update' apply_batch_id,
      concat('{"xid":"9007199254740993","seq":"',cast(id AS STRING),'"}') source_cursor_json,
      concat('edge:',cast(id AS STRING)) source_delivery_id
      FROM (SELECT id,CASE WHEN pmod(id,10)=0 THEN 'other' ELSE 'pilot' END source_system,cast(1000+(pmod((pmod(id-1,4000000)+1),32)+1)*5+(cast(floor((id-4000000-1)/4000000) AS BIGINT)+1)-1 AS BIGINT) rel_type_id,cast(pmod((pmod(id-1,4000000)+1),32)+1 AS BIGINT) source_type,cast((pmod(id-1,4000000)+1) AS BIGINT) source_id,cast(pmod((pmod((pmod(id-1,4000000)+1)-1+(cast(floor((id-4000000-1)/4000000) AS BIGINT)+1)*10,4000000)+1),32)+1 AS BIGINT) target_type,cast((pmod((pmod(id-1,4000000)+1)-1+(cast(floor((id-4000000-1)/4000000) AS BIGINT)+1)*10,4000000)+1) AS BIGINT) target_id
      FROM (SELECT (pmod(id*104729,20000000)+1)+4000000 id FROM range(200000))))
